newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania's Birzai Milk sees 1996 profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania's Birzai Milk sees 1996 profit rise.

text.p: Birzai Milk plant, which recently made an international issue of GDRs and is traded on the Lithuanian stock market, said it expected around a four percent profit rise in 1996 from the 4.3 million litas profit of 1995.

"We think that the profit of 1996 will remain on the level of the previous year and will not be high, some four percent on turnover of 96 million litas to 100 million litas," company manager Vladas Songaila told a news conference.
After the GDR launch in December, the share capital of Birzai Milk rose to 45 million litas from 21 million litas and some 57 percent of the firm is now foreign-owned, he said.
The $12.5 million GDR issue was the first carried out by a Lithuanian company.
"We aim at getting a 25 percent share of the country's dairy products market in a few years against the current 14 percent," Songaila added.
Birzai is among the top 20 Lithuanian companies in terms of turnover and exported half of its produce during 1996, mainly to Japan, France, Denmark and the Netherlands.
"The export revenue will be used to modernize the plants's packaging facilities and to boost our exports to Russia and Latvia," Songaila added.
